{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2011}}
{{main|2011 World Table Tennis Championships}}

[[Zhang Yining]] won the title in 2009 but has since retired from international table tennis.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/_front_page/ittf_full_story.asp?Year=&General_Catigory=&ID=23886&Category=&Competition_ID=&Player_ID=110579&|title=Zhang Yining Prepares to Leave China to Study in United States of America|date=2011-04-04|work=ittf.com|access-date=2011-05-19}}</ref>

[[Li Xiaoxia]] met compatriot [[Ding Ning]] in the final of this event. The latter won 12–10, 13–11, 11–9, 8–11, 8–11, 11–7.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/_front_page/ittf_full_story1.asp?ID=24327&Competition_ID=1962& |title=In Moscow a Nightmare, in Rotterdam Dreams Came True |date=2011-05-14 |work=ittf.com |access-date=2011-05-19 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121016224849/http://www.ittf.com/_front_page/ittf_full_story1.asp?ID=24327&Competition_ID=1962& |archive-date=2012-10-16 }}</ref>

==Seeds==
Based on the ITTF world ranking issued before the Championships, top 64 seeds directly entered the first round of the 128-player sized draw.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/world_events/wttc_2011/Playing_system_WTTC2011.pdf |title=2011 World TT Championships Playing System |publisher=ITTF |access-date=5 May 2011 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110322194848/http://www.ittf.com/world_events/wttc_2011/Playing_system_WTTC2011.pdf |archive-date=22 March 2011 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_wttc_web2.asp?Gender=W&Tour_ID=1962&Singles=1&Seeded_Singles=1 |title=2011 WTTC Seeds - Women's singles |work=ittf.com |access-date=5 May 2011}}</ref>
